tagline.en_US: Frigate adapted as a native Proxmox OCI LXC with persistent configuration, selectable recording storage, tmpfs cache and optional GPU or detector devices.

description.en_US: Frigate is a local network video recorder featuring real-time AI object detection for IP cameras. It uses OpenCV and TensorFlow to identify objects locally while minimizing system resource consumption. The application supports continuous 24/7 recording, retention rules based on detected objects, camera re-streaming, and low-latency live viewing.
